overview.text: Seattle icon with a revolving restaurant and glass walls for views.

text.text: People say this observation deck offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the city, mountains, and water, and a unique experience with a rotating glass floor. They highlight the friendly staff and the fun, quick elevator ride. They also like the well-stocked gift shop and the option to purchase drinks and snacks.

overview.text: Vibrant and long-running marketplace highlighting fresh produce, meats, seafood and flowers.

text.text: People say this market offers a wide variety of fresh seafood, produce, flowers, and handmade crafts. They highlight the lively atmosphere, the fun of watching the fishmongers throw fish, and the unique shopping experience. They also like the friendly vendors and staff.

overview.text: Variety of wildlife on display, plus a carousel, rainforest exhibit, and bug house.

text.text: People say this zoo offers a wide variety of animals, including gorillas, hippos, lions, and penguins, and features a historic carousel and a dinosaur exhibit. They highlight the spacious enclosures, the beautiful, natural environment with lots of vegetation, and the family-friendly atmosphere. They also like the friendly and knowledgeable staff.

overview.text: Grass-covered urban park sporting views of Seattle (especially at night) as well as Lake Union.

text.text: People say this city park offers stunning views of the Seattle skyline, Lake Union, and the Space Needle, and is a great spot for picnics, kite flying, and watching seaplanes. They highlight the peaceful and fun vibe, especially in the summer, with free DJ sets, yoga classes, and events. They also like the spacious grounds, ample parking, and free entry.

overview.text: Modern venue with sharks, seals, octopuses and otters, plus jellyfish, tide pools and touch tanks.

text.text:
People say this aquarium offers a variety of marine life, including sea otters, seals, and an octopus, and features an underwater dome and touch tanks. They also highlight the friendly and knowledgeable staff, and the family-friendly atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the admission can be expensive.

overview.text: Aerospace museum featuring 170+ aircraft and spacecraft in addition to an Apollo exhibition.

text.text: People say this museum offers a vast collection of aircraft, including the Concorde, Air Force One, and SR-71, as well as interactive exhibits and a flight simulator. They highlight the museum's family-friendly atmosphere, the opportunity to walk through historic planes, and the knowledgeable staff. They also like the membership option, which provides access to multiple visits.

overview.text: Small park atop a hill with a famed view of Seattle's skyline, plus picnic benches.

text.text: People say this city park offers stunning panoramic views of the Seattle skyline, Space Needle, and Mount Rainier, especially at sunset. They highlight the relaxing and chill vibe, and the perfect photo opportunities for capturing postcard-worthy views. They also like the easy access and free admission.

overview.text: Showcasing the work of Dale Chihuly, this venue features glass sculptures, a garden, and a glasshouse.

text.text: People say this art museum features stunning glass sculptures and a beautiful glass garden. They highlight the unique and inspiring experience, and the opportunity to witness live glass blowing demonstrations. They also like the relaxing and colorful atmosphere.

overview.text: Popular seaside park featuring fire pits, barbecues and a sandy beach.

text.text: People say this city park offers a sandy beach, trails, and stunning views of the Puget Sound and Olympic Mountains. They highlight the relaxing and chill vibe, perfect for picnics, walks, and watching the sunset, and the ample parking and free access. They also like the availability of fire pits, volleyball courts, and a dog park.

overview.text: Striking design for a vast chain library with a reading room, computer lab and a book spiral.

text.text: Visitors say this public library offers a wide variety of books, computers, and study spaces, and they praise its stunning, modern architecture. They also highlight the friendly staff and the peaceful atmosphere.

overview.text: Park offering trails, picnic facilities, and a lighthouse, plus scenic views.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful trails, a beach, and a lighthouse, with stunning views of the Puget Sound, Olympic Mountains, and Mount Rainier. They highlight the peaceful and serene atmosphere, and the opportunity for hiking, picnicking, and enjoying the sunset. They also like the dog-friendly environment and the variety of ecosystems, including forests, plains, and bluffs.

People say this museum offers a variety of exhibits showcasing movie props, musical instruments, and pop culture memorabilia, including a popular Nirvana exhibit. They highlight the interactive exhibits, such as the sound lab where visitors can play instruments, and the fun, engaging atmosphere. They also like the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: Huge outdoor space for dogs, featuring riverside trails, climbing walls and soccer fields.

text.text: Visitors say this park offers a spacious off-leash dog park, a velodrome for bike racing, and hosts concerts and events. They also highlight the park's extensive trails, playgrounds, and sports fields, making it a great place for walking, biking, and enjoying the outdoors.

overview.text: Laid-back park, forested peninsula on Lake Washington featuring a perimeter trail, interior trails, beaches and picnic facilities.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful views of the lake and Mount Rainier, as well as hiking trails, picnic spots, and a beach. They highlight the peaceful and calming atmosphere, and the well-maintained walkways and trails. They also like the free parking and lake access.

People say this airport offers direct flights and is conveniently located. They highlight the efficient, easy, and relaxing experience, as well as the clean and comfortable facilities. They also like the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: Global art collections and temporary installations housed in a downtown space with a restaurant.

text.text: Visitors say this art museum offers a diverse collection of modern and historical art, including Asian, African, and Native American art, as well as special exhibits. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the convenient location in Volunteer Park.

People say this event venue offers a variety of attractions, including the Space Needle, Chihuly Garden and Glass, and the Museum of Pop Culture, as well as festivals, concerts, and a playground. They highlight the beautiful views, relaxing atmosphere, and fun experience, especially during events and festivals. They also like the convenient access via monorail and the availability of food and drink options.

displayName.text: The Gum Wall at Unexpected Productions Improv

overview.text: Alley with an ever-evolving display of chewed gum plastered to the wall.

text.text:
People say this tourist attraction offers a unique experience with colorful, quirky, and interesting art. They also highlight the iconic, historic, and creative atmosphere, and the fun photo opportunities.

Some reviews mention there can be gross gum.

overview.text: Lakefront park featuring playgrounds and water sports facilities.

text.text: People say this city park offers a dog park, beach, swimming area, walking trails, and picnic spots. They highlight the peaceful and quiet vibe, and the beautiful views of the lake and mountains. They also like the large size of the park and the ample parking.

overview.text: Museum devoted to science, nature, art and other subjects via hands-on exhibits.

text.text: People say this children's museum offers a wide variety of hands-on activities, including a grocery store, farm, water games, and an outdoor play area with bikes and a course. They highlight the fair price, the clean and well-maintained facilities, and the fun and imaginative experiences for children of all ages. They also like the friendly, helpful, and attentive staff.

displayName.text: Washington State Capitol Building and Campus

overview.text: Expansive state park featuring a boardwalk trail through an old-growth forest, plus a sandy beach and campsites.

text.text: Visitors say this state park offers scenic hiking trails, a peaceful lake ideal for kayaking and fishing, and a beer garden with ice cream. They also highlight the well-maintained facilities, including clean bathrooms and campsites, and the friendly and helpful staff.

overview.text: State park featuring sand and gravel beaches, clamming and hiking trails.

text.text: People say this state park offers a lovely pebble beach, great trails, and opportunities for clamming, picnicking, and kayaking. They highlight the peaceful and relaxed atmosphere, and the beautiful views of the sound. They also like the clean restrooms and the availability of picnic tables and barbecues.

overview.text: Pond-lined, family-friendly park with sports fields, a skateboard area and a playground.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, soccer fields, tennis courts, pickleball courts, a skate park, and open fields. They highlight the park is clean, spacious, and has a playground for children. They also like the convenient parking and well-maintained facilities.

overview.text: Park featuring a river leading to cascading waterfalls and a fish-spawning hatchery.

text.text: People say this tourist attraction offers beautiful waterfalls, scenic trails, and opportunities to view salmon runs. They highlight the peaceful and relaxing vibe, and the easy, accessible walk. They also like the interesting history and well-maintained park.

overview.text: Expansive park with playgrounds and trails leading to the Deschutes River for tubing and swimming.

text.text: People say this park offers a river with swimming access, trails, and sports fields, including soccer and baseball. They highlight the clean environment, ample parking, and the availability of both sunny and shady spots. They also like the spaciousness, the playground, and the covered area for gatherings.

overview.text: Well-maintained park featuring picnic areas, a rose garden and a playground.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful trails, a beach, picnic areas, and a playground. They highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, including bathrooms with running water, and the peaceful, family-friendly atmosphere. They also like the variety of short trails suitable for all levels and the opportunities to connect with nature.

overview.text: Relaxing park boasting waterfalls and fish ladders amid scenic trails.

text.text: People say this park offers beautiful waterfalls, scenic trails, and a fish ladder, and is a great place to see the salmon run. They highlight the peaceful and relaxing vibe, and the easy access from the highway. They also like the clean and well-maintained trails, and the informative signs about the area's history.

overview.text: Waterside state park offering camping, fishing and shellfish harvesting, as well as picnicking.

text.text:
People say this state park offers a beautiful beach, campground, and opportunities for clamming and oyster harvesting. They also highlight the peaceful and serene vibe, and the availability of picnic tables and parking.

Other reviews mention the restrooms can be unavailable.

overview.text: Kid-friendly park featuring swings, slides, and other playground equipment.

text.text: People say this park offers a fantastic playground with a zip line, swings, and slides, as well as walking trails along the river and to Capitol Lake. They highlight the beautiful and peaceful surroundings, and the stroller-friendly paths. They also like the ample parking and restrooms.

overview.text: Pumpkin patch and corn maze combo, plus sunflower fields and haunted house.

text.text:
People say this pumpkin patch offers a fun corn maze, a haunted maze, and a sunflower field. They also highlight the friendly staff, the family-friendly atmosphere, and the many photo opportunities.

Other reviews mention the prices can be high.

People say this state park offers well-maintained campgrounds, hiking trails, and river access, with opportunities for swimming and wildlife viewing. They highlight the quiet, peaceful, and clean atmosphere, and the spacious, private campsites. They also like the new restrooms and showers, and the helpful park rangers.

overview.text: Park with forest and playground trails leading to a rocky beach, plus picnic spots.

text.text: People say this park offers scenic trails leading to a beach, with opportunities for hiking, picnicking, and enjoying views. They highlight the clean trails, roadways, and facilities, and the peaceful, serene atmosphere. They also like the informational signage and the availability of amenities such as restrooms, shelters, and playgrounds.

overview.text: Family-friendly park featuring a boardwalk, a playground, moorage for boats and a tower.

text.text: People say this park offers a boardwalk, playground, and scenic views. They highlight the enjoyable walks, the opportunity to listen to music, and the chance to meet new people. They also like the dog-friendly boardwalk and the availability of restrooms.

overview.text: Public park with a playground, picnic tables, basketball and tennis courts, trails, and baseball fields.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, picnic areas, a playground, tennis courts, and walking trails. They highlight the easy trails, shady spots, and clean restrooms. They also like the open fields, benches, and picnic shelters.

overview.text: Fun park featuring baseball fields, a playground and a forest with hiking trails and fairy houses.

text.text: People say this park offers baseball fields, a playground with a zip line, shelters, and walking trails. They highlight the park's fun options for all ages, including a toddler jungle gym and a separate area for older kids. They also like the well-maintained facilities, such as the clean bathrooms and picnic areas, and the ample free parking.

overview.text: Forested space with scenic vistas offering opportunities for hiking, shooting, and riding dirt bikes.

text.text: People say this park offers great trails and camping for horses, as well as hiking, biking, and motorcycle riding. They highlight the spacious areas, well-maintained roads and campgrounds, and abundant wildlife. They also like the opportunity to connect with nature and enjoy a peaceful experience.

overview.text: Relaxed park with a beach area and waterfront RV parking, plus docks and marina.

text.text: People say this state park offers scenic campsites, docks, and water access. They highlight the peaceful and quiet vibe, and the clean facilities. They also like the beautiful views and the coastal breeze.

overview.text: Picturesque national park with a campground, glaciers and an inn, offering snow tubing, hiking and mountaineering.

text.text: People say this national park offers breathtaking views of Mount Rainier, glaciers, waterfalls, and meadows, and features numerous hiking trails, including the Skyline Trail. They highlight the reservation system helps control crowds, and the park is beautiful in all seasons. They also like the helpful park rangers and the informative visitor center.

overview.text: Short waterfall known for its scenic views of Mount Rainier.

text.text: Visitors say this waterfall offers stunning views, especially with Mount Rainier in the background, and is accessible via a paved trail and a short hike. They also highlight the beautiful scenery, wildflowers, and the opportunity to see the falls from different vantage points, including a bridge.

overview.text: Mountainous 3.3-mile loop dotted with ponds, wildflowers and fall colors featuring distant views of snowcapped peaks.

text.text: People say this hiking area offers stunning views of Mount Rainier, beautiful lakes, and abundant wildflowers in July. They highlight the easy to moderate trails, suitable for families and hikers of all levels, with varied terrain including shady spots, waterfalls, and snowmelt. They also like the well-marked trails, ample parking, and picnic areas.

overview.text: Gondola ride up Mount Rainier with views of the Cascade Range, plus a restaurant and snack bar.

text.text: People say this tourist attraction offers a smooth gondola ride with spectacular views of Mount Rainier and the Cascade Range. They highlight the easy ticket purchase process, the well-maintained facilities, and the friendly and attentive staff. They also like the gift shop, cafe, and full-service restaurant at the summit.

overview.text: Popular alpine trail winding through meadows for 360-degree views of Mount Rainier at a lookout.

text.text: People say this hiking area offers stunning views of Mount Rainier and the surrounding mountain ranges, with breathtaking scenery along the entire trail. They highlight the gradual incline, making it a manageable and enjoyable hike, and the well-maintained trail conditions. They also like the friendly and helpful volunteers on the trail.

overview.text: Fire lookout reached by a 5.7-mi. trail offering scenic views of Mount Rainier and nearby peaks.

text.text: People say this historical landmark offers a scenic hike with stunning views of Mount Rainier and spectacular sunsets. They highlight the moderate difficulty of the trail, the well-maintained path, and the opportunity to see wildlife such as mountain goats and chipmunks. They also like the 360-degree views from the lookout and recommend bringing layers, sun protection, and plenty of water.

overview.text: Popular park featuring a beach to swim from and a playground for kids, plus picnic areas and a campground for tents and RVs.

text.text: People say this state park offers a beautiful lake with clear water, perfect for paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing, as well as hiking trails and picnic areas. They highlight the well-maintained campsites, clean restrooms, and convenient location, making it a great spot for camping and outdoor activities. They also like the scenic views and peaceful atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and enjoying nature.

overview.text: Lookout for mountain views and short hikes, with picnicking areas and friendly staff.

text.text: People say this vista point offers amazing views and a fire lookout. They highlight the hike can be short and steep, or you can drive to the top, and there are picnic tables and a vault toilet. They also like the friendly and informative volunteers stationed at the fire lookout.

overview.text: Challenging hike to a fire lookout with views of Mount Rainier and a lake.

text.text: Hikers say this historical landmark offers stunning views of Mount Rainier and a nearby lake, with opportunities to spot wildlife. They also highlight the well-maintained trails and the moderate difficulty level, making it accessible for most hikers.

overview.text: Snow-covered hiking trail with scenic views leading from Paradise Visitor Center.

text.text: Hikers say this vista point offers stunning views of snow-capped mountains, bright green trees, and clear blue skies. They also highlight the moderate hike, which provides great exercise and incredible views along the entire way.

overview.text: Challenging, dog-friendly trail past a lake with sweeping views of the surrounding mountains.
Hiking area boasting a lake, forest, and campsites.
Park with trails for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing, plus a restroom.

text.text: Hikers say this hiking area offers easy to moderate trails through a lush rainforest with towering trees, soft trails, and stunning views of the Carbon River. They also highlight the peaceful and magical atmosphere, perfect for escaping the crowds.

overview.text: Area with trails, suspension bridges, and trees, described by some as magical.
Clean state park hosting camping and hiking as well as a lake with beach access.

text.text: People say this state park offers a beach, picnic tables, and a playground. They highlight the clean facilities, warm water showers, and beautiful setting. They also like the secluded and kid-friendly atmosphere.

overview.text: Family-friendly lake, river and stream hike boasting a campground and a couple of bridges.

text.text: People say this hiking area offers a short and easy hike to Greenwater Lakes, with beautiful old growth, wildlife, and clear, serene lakes and ponds. They highlight the well-maintained trail, varying terrain, and the peaceful and beautiful scenery, especially in spring with lush greenery and wildflowers. They also like the dog-friendly trail and the availability of campsites.

overview.text: Hiking area with views of Mount Rainier, waterfalls, forests, and meadows.
Small park with interpretive trails and old-growth forests, plus views.

text.text: People say this state park offers beautiful river access and scenic trails winding through old-growth forests. They highlight the easy, peaceful, and beautiful trails, and the relaxing atmosphere with the sound of a rushing river. They also like the informative interpretive center and the dog-friendly environment.
